item.title: Vatican: Pope Leo to leave hospital Saturday
item.description: The Vatican said Pope Leo XIV will be discharged Saturday, four days after surgery.

item.title: Judge dismisses indictment against actor Timothy Busfield
item.description: A New Mexico judge dismissed an indictment against actor and director Timothy Busfield on four counts of sexual contact of a minor.

item.title: Bend, Oregon school shooting: suspect identified, police say
item.description: Three children and one teacher were killed after a shooter forced his way into a Bend, Oregon, elementary school and opened fire, authorities said.

item.title: Trump signs order waiving Graham Act sanctions on Russia
item.description: The new sanctions and tariffs had been set to take effect in two days.
